clips.title: The story
paras: Bronzebeard the Elder is a Lunar Festival encounter with Elder Bronzebeard within the dwarven mountain city of Ironforge. Honoring him during this ancestral celebration rewards travelers with wisdom and a token of his esteem. It reflects the deep reverence the folk of Khaz Modan hold for their forebears and long-lived heritage.

During the Lunar Festival, spirits and venerable elders manifest across Azeroth to share their wisdom with travelers honoring the past. In Ironforge, Elder Bronzebeard stands as an embodiment of the stalwart resilience of the Bronzebeard clan. When approached by adventurers seeking to pay their respects, he expresses quiet satisfaction that the people of this land still acknowledge and honor the lineage of the olden races.

The encounter requires no great trial or perilous expedition, asking only that travelers pause, acknowledge the elder's presence, and offer greeting. In turn, Elder Bronzebeard extends his well wishes and bestows a Coin of Ancestry. These sacred festival tokens serve as physical reminders of the living connection between modern heroes and the generations who forged Khaz Modan from stone and fire.
